source: A fantasy mystical floating boss arena island, small and compact about 40-50 studs across. The island is a floating chunk of earth with a flat top fighting platform. The bottom tapers down into jagged rocky points like a floating island. On top there is a circular flat stone arena platform with ancient cracked runes carved into it. Around the edges of the arena platform are several glowing magical crystals (purple and cyan) jutting out at angles, providing a mystical glow. On one side there are ancient ruined stone pillars and arches, partially broken, giving a mystical ancient ruin feel. Small floating rocks orbit around the main island. The overall color scheme is dark stone with purple and cyan magical accents. The arena platform should be suitable for a 1v1 boss fight with enough open space to move around. Make it look enchanted and ominous with crystal formations. Expose attributes for crystal color, crystal glow intensity, island size, and platform diameter so these can be tweaked.
scene_prompt: Create a compact fantasy mystical floating boss-arena island, about 40–50 studs across. A chunk of dark earth and stone floats in space, with a broad flat top and an underside tapering into jagged rocky points. Center the layout on a circular, open stone fighting platform sized for a 1v1 encounter, its surface carved with ancient cracked runes. Several angled purple and cyan glowing crystal formations rise around the platform edges, while one side holds partially collapsed ancient stone pillars and arches. Small rocks orbit the main island; use dark stone throughout with ominous enchanted purple and cyan accents.
blob:
### Genre
`Action` is the dominant genre: this is a compact 1v1 boss-fight arena, not an explorable floating-island world.

### Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, a single flat circular combat floor on the island’s top, with the island edge defining the encounter boundary. This follows the Boss Raid preset; retain its arena-and-boss-emitter intent, but omit unrequested ring-out hazards and destructible cover.

### Config requirements
No additional image-config options apply. The requested crystals, ruined pillars, runes, floating rocks, and tapered island are concrete scene components rather than generic gameplay options.

### Layout requirements
Place one `spawner-npc` at the exact center of the rune-carved arena as the boss’s encounter origin. Keep it clear of the outer crystal ring and the ruined structures so the boss has open movement space. No other placed gameplay volumes are required by the prompt.

### Layout components
Build one compact floating island, about 40–50 studs across, isolated in open space. Its dark-earth and dark-stone mass has a broad, level top and a lower body tapering into jagged rocky points. Center a broad circular stone fighting platform on the top, sized to leave a narrow irregular stone rim around it; carve ancient cracked runes across the open floor. Arrange several angled glowing crystal formations around the platform perimeter, using purple and cyan light without blocking the central 1v1 movement area. On one side of the arena, cluster partially collapsed ancient stone pillars and broken arches as a single ruin vignette, kept outside the main combat circle. Add small floating rocks orbiting around the island at varied distances. The boundary is the island edge and surrounding void. Frame the island centrally in an elevated three-quarter view, with the ruins on one side and the jagged underside visibly descending below the arena.

### Render order
Use `isometric` first and treat it as authoritative, because the island silhouette, exposed underside, crystals, and ruin composition matter more than complex navigational topology.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is small, driven by the stated 40–50-stud footprint and single 1v1 arena. Theme: ominous enchanted ancient ruins, dark stone, purple-and-cyan crystal magic. Use `P0`: the playable area is one unobstructed surface; the visible tapered underside is scenic structure rather than overlapping playable layers.
